**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Correct the cache-read multiplier comment**

For requests to `claude-opus-5-5` or `claude-sonnet-5-5`, this line now applies `0.05`, but the adjacent method comment still states that Anthropic cache reads bill at `0.1x`. That contradiction documents the new billing behavior incorrectly and can cause later pricing maintenance to use the wrong rate; update it to distinguish the `0.1x` default from the per-model override. Repository guidance explicitly requires stale comments to be updated when behavior changes.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L10-L10](https://github.com/we-promise/sure/blob/a734484d6532cf6432d9241306cf6326b2e76ea5/AGENTS.md#L10-L10)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Support OpenRouter’s Claude 5.5 model IDs.** The documented OpenRouter route uses IDs such as `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`, but these rows use `5-5`. After removing `anthropic/`, `find_pricing` cannot match the dotted ID, so requests have no cost estimate and are excluded from cost totals. The same issue affects Haiku and Opus. ([openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5?utm_source=openai)) Normalize the version separator or add aliases, and test the OpenRouter IDs.
